title: Ralph killswitch configuration
description: Canonical schema version 2. Input may use documented camelCase aliases (dryRun, bannedTools, toolDenylist, bannedPaths, allowedTools, allowedPaths, allowedCommands, allowedPatterns, deniedArgumentPatterns, customRules) or nested alias containers tools.deny / tools.denylist and arguments.denyPatterns. The shared Python normalizer rejects duplicate canonical/alias pairs, unknown keys, wrong types, invalid regex, and invalid custom-rule shapes, then emits deterministic snake_case JSON.

enabled.description: Set to false to temporarily disable the killswitch (overrides env).

dry_run.description: When true, log violations without killing the runner. Alias: dryRun.

banned_tools.description: Tool names or glob patterns disallowed before invocation. Alias: bannedTools.

tool_denylist.description: Exact tool names denied for unified MCP/native policy. Aliases: toolDenylist, tools.deny, tools.denylist.

banned_paths.description: File/path glob patterns the killswitch will block. Alias: bannedPaths.

allowed_commands.description: Command substring allowlist exceptions. Alias: allowedCommands.

allowed_patterns.description: Command regex allowlist exceptions. Alias: allowedPatterns.

denied_argument_patterns.description: Argument deny rules. Aliases: deniedArgumentPatterns, arguments.denyPatterns.

tool.description: Optional tool name; empty/omitted matches any tool.

argument.description: Optional argument key to extract before matching.

pattern.description: Literal or regex pattern depending on mode.

custom_rules.description: Command rules using plain string matching (match) or regex (pattern). Alias: customRules.

match.description: Plain substring to match against the command (case-sensitive).

pattern.description: Regex pattern to match against the command.
